verdict.rationale: ROS 2 is an open-source robotics middleware framework that users install and run themselves. Nothing in the evidence shows a vendor-hosted service that ingests user data, so an opt-out of AI training is a category error for this product type, not a missing feature. The only AI-adjacent mention is that bags can store synthetic training data (ros2-docs-69); that is a user-side recording feature and does not make the training opt-out axis apply.
